method: Stored float32 vertices and polygons from SDNA; both explicit quad diagonals; independent solid-angle interior witnesses
extraction_checks: Blender 5.2 SDNA field lengths, block sizes and mesh-local pointer scopes checked
8 uniquely named objects; identity Euler transforms; no parents, modifiers, constraints, animation or shape keys
position/corner attribute lengths, polygon offsets and every vertex index checked; closed vertical prism topology checked
limits: NOT actual Blender evaluated loop triangles: runtime approval retries timed out. Both explicit quad diagonals are diagnostic alternatives, not a runtime acceptance.
Private SDNA extractor depends on local Blender 5.2 header helper and Python 3.14 zstd; it is a one-file diagnostic, not a supported portable blend parser.
Interior witnesses certify only the two reconstructed closed triangle shells; self-intersections and all mixed runtime tessellations are not exhaustively checked.
Partial/no roof coverage is not a clearance pass. Estimated post height/radius and roof curvature remain unresolved; no automatic trimming permitted.
No v15 model, visual rendering, game export, architectural acceptance or performance result.
Stored arrays also compared against float32 generator fixtures to catch extraction mistakes; source agreement is not independent architectural validation.
